title: How to build a million dollar one-person business with AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" is clear—AI automates tasks, scales fast, and cuts costs with protocols like LangChain and AutoGPT. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "To" is about execution—without the right tools, like fine-tuning models on Hugging Face or using API keys, you'll fail. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My method uses real-world data pipelines and integrates with Zapier for instant automation—no need for a team. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without a clear "to"—a strategy, a niche, a product—your AI is just a toy, not a business. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Build the right thing, not just the right way. (4 sec)
